prompt: A school has $245$ cans and needs $500$. They will collect $c$ more cans to reach the goal. Write the equation and solve for $c$.
hint: The cans they have plus the cans still to collect must equal the goal.

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Think of it as a gap on a number line from $245$ up to $500$. The value of $c$ is the length of that gap.
The cans they have plus the cans still to collect must equal the goal.
The equation is $245 + c = 500$. Subtract $245$ from both sides to find $c$.
$500 - 245 = 255$, so the school must collect $255$ more cans.

explanation: The cans already collected plus $c$ more must reach the goal: $245 + c = 500$.
Subtract $245$ from both sides to undo the addition and leave $c$ alone.
Working out the subtraction on the right gives $c = 500 - 245 = 255$.
The school needs $255$ more cans, and $245 + 255 = 500$ confirms it.
